Find answers to common questions about document conversions, OCR, permissions, and app features.
❓ Why can\'t I select or copy text from some PDF files?

Some PDF files are created from scanned paper documents or photos rather than digital text. These are image-based PDFs.\n\nTo extract and copy text from image PDFs, use our built-in AI \'OCR Text Extract\' tool from the Tools tab!
❓ Why do some documents fail to open or convert?

A document may fail if:
• It is protected by password or DRM encryption.
• The file is corrupted or incompletely downloaded.
• Device RAM memory is insufficient for extremely large files.

Solution: Remove password protection or ensure the document is fully downloaded before converting.
❓ How do I scan documents using Camera or Gallery?

Tap \'Scan Document\' on the Home tab. You can choose:\n• \'Capture with Camera\': Takes a photo of your paper document directly.\n• \'Select from Gallery\': Chooses photos from your device to digitise into PDF.
🔒 Are my documents private and secure?
Yes! All document conversions, PDF merging, compression, signatures, and OCR processing happen 100% locally on your device. No files are ever uploaded to cloud servers.
🗑️ How do I manage files or empty the Trash?
Go to the \'Files\' tab and select the \'Trash\' section. Tap \'Empty Trash 🗑️\' to permanently clear all deleted items.

🔒 AsterDocs Privacy & Security Policy

1. On-Device Local Processing:
All document operations, including PDF conversions, OCR text extraction, compression, merging, and signatures, take place 100% locally on your device. No document files are ever uploaded or transmitted to external servers.

2. User Account Data:
Your account credentials and preferences are securely encrypted locally on your device.

3. Permissions & Usage:
• Camera: Used exclusively for document scanning when initiated by you.
• Storage/Media: Used to read and save document files you select.

4. Billing & Subscriptions:
Subscriptions are processed securely via official Google Play Billing.

5. Account & Data Deletion:
You have full control over your data and may request account deletion at any time.
